formula_name: ASME Section VIII Div 1 Cylindrical Shell Thickness
description: Calculates required thickness of cylindrical pressure vessel shell under internal pressure per ASME VIII Div 1.
applicability_conditions: t <= 0.5 * R or P <= 0.385 * S * E (thin wall assumption per UG-27)
applicability: design pressure, radius, allowable stress, joint efficiency known
non_applicability_conditions: Thick wall vessels (t > 0.5 R) where Lamé equations govern
assumptions: ASME UG-27 thin cylindrical shell hoop stress formula
source_reference: ASME Section VIII Division 1 UG-27(c)(1) — Engineering reference / prototype knowledge - requires engineering validation.
